### Crash report or logs
Please attach your crash report or relevant log files.

Crash reports are usually located in the `crash-reports` folder inside your Minecraft instance. If no crash report was generated, provide the latest log from the `logs` folder.

### Mods or settings changed
Have you added, removed, or updated any mods, or changed the modpack's Minecraft version? If so, explain what you changed.

### Additional information
Include screenshots, error messages, or anything else that might help identify the cause.

### Before submitting
- Confirm you're using Minecraft 1.21.1, the version this modpack was made for.
- Check whether this crash has already been reported.
- Remove personal information from logs before attaching them.
